instruction: Create a Thunderbird configuration for bot@automation.net that permits outgoing messages without requiring any incoming mail server setup.

metadata.explanation: Verify that Thunderbird is configured with bot@automation.net account for send-only operation with SMTP server configured

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies all 3 critical requirements from the instruction
VERIFIED: Email identity configured as bot@automation.net (mail.identity.id1.useremail eq 'bot@automation.net')
VERIFIED: SMTP server configured for outgoing messages (mail.identity.id1.smtpServer and mail.smtpserver.smtp1.hostname must exist)
VERIFIED: No incoming mail server setup (unexpect rules ensure mail.server.server1.type is NOT 'imap'/'pop3' and mail.server.server1.hostname does NOT exist)
Getter logic correct: get_vm_file retrieves prefs.js from Thunderbird profile directory
Metric logic correct: check_thunderbird_prefs parses preferences and checks both 'expect' and 'unexpect' rules, returns 1.0 only if all expect rules match AND all unexpect rules do NOT match
The evaluator correctly implements send-only verification by checking presence of SMTP config and absence of IMAP/POP3 config

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
